title: Artin–Schreier roots in a separably closed field
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed] [def-weil-field] of characteristic $p>0$ [def-pc-field-characteristic]. For every $a\in K$ there exists $z\in K$ such that $z^p-z=a$.
